subject: POC hands-on orientation & load rehearsal — roster, roles, capacity windows
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@averytech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@averytech.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC orientation + hands-on run (proposal)

Hi Connor / Laura —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our engineering and product teams are excited to move into a short hands-on POC so we can validate routing behavior and run a focused load rehearsal. High-level asks:

- 90-minute kickoff to align stakeholders, roles, and success criteria
- 2-hour hands-on session (prompt review + routing config)
- 1-hour stress/rehearsal window (burst tokens, KV cache tests)

Proposed days: Tue 2027-04-13 (AM PT), Thu 2027-04-15 (late PM PT), or Mon 2027-04-18 (flex). We can supply 3 engineers on our side (Priya, Michael, and myself).

Attached is a draft POC agenda (POC-Agenda-v3.pdf). Can you confirm internal attendees and whether Redwood needs any special network/egress permission for the load window?

Goals/success criteria for us:
- <10% throughput variance under synthetic burst
- Prompt fidelity above our baseline pass-rate for the typical 2k token prompts
- Clear routing policy to move to lower-cost model if latency > 200ms for p95

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if you prefer to triage slots.

—Jordan
Jordan Mills
Director, Platform Engineering | Avery Tech
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@averytech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC orientation + hands-on run (proposal)

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear goals. Laura, Karthik and Marissa are looped for scheduling and run-booking:
- Laura will own stakeholder & success-criteria alignment
- Karthik will lead routing/infra setup for the load windows
- Marissa will coordinate prompts and acceptance tests

Quick notes on availability: Tue 4/13 AM PT we have partial conflicts; Thu 4/15 late PM PT looks plausible but Karthik has a recurring call at 5pm PT. Mon 4/18 is the most flexible across our engineering roster. Would you be able to do Mon 4/18 10:00–13:00 PT for the combined orientation + hands-on + stress window (we'd break it into 60/90/60 segments)? That would let us run a short warm-up and then a dedicated 1-hour stress window at the end.

Network/egress: we'll need a short checklist (ports / whitelisted IP ranges). If you don't have that ready, Laura can send a minimal checklist — and Karthik will confirm any VPN jumpboxes.

I've attached the agenda you sent and added a few Redwood-specific checkpoints. Looking to confirm attendee list and a final calendar invite if 4/18 works.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@averytech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@averytech.com>, Michael Reed <mreed@averytech.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC orientation + hands-on run (proposal)

Thanks — 4/18 looks good in principle, but Michael just flagged a calendar conflict with an exec offsite that morning. Would it be possible to shift to 4/18 13:00–16:00 PT instead (same blocks, just later)? That would let Michael join the orientation portion at 13:00 and then Priya and I stay for the hands-on and stress window.

If that works for your team, we can lock it and I'll share the attendee list (names + roles) and a short internal prep doc.

On the network checklist, we don't anticipate VPN gymnastics; we'll rely on whitelisted outbound IPs. I can share our side's network contact if Karthik wants to sync.

—Jordan
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC orientation + hands-on run (proposal)

Jordan / Connor —

13:00–16:00 PT on Mon 2027-04-18 works for Redwood. I'll send a concise attendee/roles roster this afternoon. Karthik — please see the network request attached (network-requirements.xlsx). Highlights:

- Whitelist our outbound IPs for the stress window (we'll provide 1 IP range)
- Allow TLS egress to ports 443/5222 (for telemetry and test runner)
- If you expect >100 rps during the stress window, notify us so we can stage additional worker capacity

I'll also include the acceptance tests for prompt fidelity (Marissa's list) in the invite.

Thanks — Laura

Subject: Final: POC orientation + hands-on + stress rehearsal (Mon 2027-04-18 13:00–16:00 PT)

Thanks everyone — invite is sent for Mon 18 Apr, 13:00–16:00 PT. Calendar stub: POC Orientation (13:00–14:00) / Hands-on prompts & routing (14:00–15:00) / Stress rehearsal (15:00–16:00).

Pre-reads and day-of checklist:
- POC-Agenda-v3.pdf (attached) — update: we've added the acceptance test matrix in section 2
- network-requirements.xlsx (attached) — Karthik will coordinate IP ranges with Priya's network contact
- Runbook link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cPOC-Runbook (short operational checklist)

Roles at a glance:
- Connor (Redwood): session lead + runbook owner
- Karthik (Redwood): infra & routing config
- Marissa (Redwood): prompt acceptance tests + evals
- Jordan (Avery): product owner / success criteria owner
- Priya (Avery): infra liaison
- Michael (Avery): exec observer / sign-off for acceptance

Success criteria (top-line):
- p95 latency < 200ms during 90% of steady-state intervals
- Stress window: sustain 120 rps with <15% throughput variance
- Prompt pass-rate >= 92% against acceptance test set

If anything changes on your side, reply to this thread and we'll adjust. Looking forward to it.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
